name: What should I prepare before an in-home accessibility remodeling consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an in-home accessibility remodeling consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should gather exact measurements of personal mobility devices, identify daily problem areas, and note structural concerns. Measure the width of wheelchairs or walkers to determine the necessary door and hallway clearance. Take inventory of where slips or balance loss occur most frequently, such as bathroom thresholds or exterior steps. Before our initial walk-through, consider whether plumbing fixtures like toilets or sinks need height adjustments. Having this information ready allows Abraham Becerra to evaluate framing, subflooring, and finish options accurately during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Note your mobility device dimensions, list daily trouble spots, and identify which doorways, fixtures, or floor transitions cause mobility hurdles.
